additions.title: Yale Young Global Scholars 2027
additions.description: Two-week residential academic programme. Early Action closes 15 October 2026; Regular Decision closes 6 January 2027, both at 11:59pm Eastern Time.
additions.eligibility: Age 16–18 on 18 July 2027; current sophomore/junior or equivalent; specified 2027–2029 graduation cohorts; English fluency; first-time participants. All countries eligible.

discovery.fees: US$7,500 tuition, plus travel. Application: US$85 Early Action or US$100 Regular Decision. Need-based tuition aid and application fee waivers available.
discovery.notes: Check graduation-cohort requirements on the source page. Login/register portal loaded; no application submitted.

additions.title: Hansen Leadership Institute 2027
additions.description: Leadership and peacebuilding programme, 29 June–20 July 2027. International deadline: 15 January; US deadline: 15 March 2027, both 11:55pm Pacific Time.
additions.eligibility: Age 20–25 on 1 July 2027; at least one university year completed. Non-enrolled applicants must be 2025/2026 graduates. Academic referee verifies English. Full attendance required. US and international routes have different deadlines; country-specific rules not confirmed.

discovery.fees: Airfare, accommodation, meals and programme funded. Passport and personal spending remain the participant’s responsibility.
discovery.notes: Application platform returned a JavaScript shell, so form access is not confirmed. International applicants must use the earlier 15 January deadline.

additions.title: Oxford Farming Conference Breaking Barriers 2027
additions.description: Eight funded places for people facing barriers to entering food and agriculture. Includes UK gatherings and the January 2027 conference.
additions.eligibility: UK residents facing barriers in food/agriculture. No current sector employment or study required. Full programme attendance required. Upper age limit needs clarification: page says both under 30 and 18–30.
additions.location: Oxford, London and Shropshire, United Kingdom

discovery.fees: Breaking Barriers has eight fully funded places; travel coverage not confirmed. The separate standard Scholars route costs the sponsor £1,000 plus VAT and excludes travel.
discovery.notes: Breaking Barriers deadline: 16 October 2026 at 5pm. Use its direct form. Standard Scholars text elsewhere on the page has a conflicting deadline year; that separate route is not imported.

additions.title: UNICEF Internship Programme — vacancy discovery
additions.description: Programme directory for student and graduate internships. Individual vacancies have their own deadlines and restrictions; this is not a single confirmed open placement.
additions.eligibility: 18+; enrolled undergraduate/postgraduate/PhD or graduated within two years. Relevant language proficiency and strong academics required. Immediate relatives at UNICEF or relatives in the reporting line disqualify. Country, work authorisation and education restrictions vary by vacancy.

discovery.fees: Monthly stipend; travel/visa contribution may be available. Applicant fees not confirmed in the reviewed page.
discovery.notes: Vacancy directory loaded. A specific placement and its application form were not verified. Year-round vacancy advertising does not mean every vacancy has rolling applications.
